abstract.text: A record of what I’ve shipped, improved, and broken (then fixed) across my career.

inlineContent.text: 12+ years. 7 companies. Millions of users. Here’s the log.
Senior iOS Developer · Frankfurt, Germany · January 2024 – Present
Building and scaling a white-label iOS platform that powers 70+ branded
transit applications across multiple markets.
70+ branded apps
— Architected and maintained the white-label platform
core; improved code reuse, scalability, and multi-tenant feature delivery.
Real-time sync
— Implemented Firebase synchronization with async stream
throttling for updates; reduced UI state drift and latency-related defects.
Accessibility
— Improved VoiceOver compliance (labels, hints, focus
behavior) across critical user journeys.
Test automation
— Expanded unit, behavior, and snapshot test coverage;
migrated legacy tests to modern Swift testing patterns.
DocC in CI/CD
— Automated documentation generation in release workflows,
cutting manual overhead per release.
Senior iOS Developer · Izmir, Turkey · June 2021 – December 2023
The most technically demanding chapter so far. Built internal tooling, shared libraries,
and real-time sync infrastructure used by 100K+ monthly active users.
−70% setup time
— Deployed a bootstrap script for swift installation of
3rd-party tools and libraries across iOS projects. New devs could be productive
on day one.
−3K lines per project
— Engineered shared common libraries used across
multiple apps, eliminating redundant code at scale.
−40% defects
— Introduced code reviews and a robust unit + snapshot testing
culture across the team.
+30% performance
— Improved native iOS codebase in coordination with the
solutions architect; profiled and resolved memory leaks systematically.
Real-time sync
— Headed Firebase synchronization for seamless data transfer
to 100K+ monthly active users using Realm with model change observation.
Color management tooling
— Engineered a script to consolidate color
definitions project-wide; eliminated bugs caused by inconsistent color usage.
Mobile Team Lead · Izmir, Turkey · March 2020 – June 2021
First leadership role. Led a team of 5, shipped two new apps, and refactored three more.
300K+ users
— Directed end-to-end development of an intuitive navigation system
in collaboration with UX designers.
Team of 5
— Ran one-on-ones, managed workload distribution, and mentored
junior developers.
Introduced Jira
— Led the migration from ad-hoc task tracking to structured
project management; gave managers real visibility into progress.
Agile Scrum
— Implemented sprint methodology to increase project velocity
and delivery predictability.
On-time delivery
— Coordinated effective project pairing that resulted in
two new apps shipped on schedule plus three refactors.
Senior iOS Developer · Izmir, Turkey · July 2019 – March 2020
Worked on BIP, one of Turkey’s largest messaging platforms.
3.5M monthly / 400K daily active users
— Contributed to BIP, proactively
detecting and resolving memory leaks through deep application profiling.
Core Data + XMPP
— Streamlined data storage with efficient entity classes;
enabled seamless data sync using XMPP protocol.
Analytics
— Implemented Mixpanel and Google Analytics tracking to deliver
actionable product insights.
Tooling
— Used Instruments and Crashlytics to prevent crashes and optimize
performance continuously.
Senior iOS Developer · Izmir, Turkey · January 2019 – July 2019
Worked on Finansbank, one of Turkey’s flagship banking apps.
2M+ active users
— Designed and maintained the Finansbank iOS app for a
massive user base.
Code quality
— Conducted analysis, optimization, and improvement cycles to
elevate application performance and reusability.
Mentorship
— Collaborated with fellow developers, offering expert guidance
and helping the team meet aggressive timelines.
iOS Developer · Izmir, Turkey · April 2017 – January 2019
Broad exposure to consumer apps, from health/food to music tech.
App Store launches
— Shipped and maintained
Innit
and
ShopWell
, two
consumer apps garnering significant downloads.
Cross-functional
— Collaborated closely with UX and back-end teams; also
contributed React.js + Redux front-end work on a
“Shazam for artists”
project.
Logging & observability
— Leveraged PaperTrail and Mixpanel for effective
bug tracking and user behavior analysis.
Git discipline
— Maintained code quality through daily reviews, frequent
builds, and structured version control workflows.
iOS Developer
· Kentkart · Izmir, Turkey · 2015 – 2017
Built transit/mobility applications for smart city infrastructure.
Software Test Engineer
· Cybersoft · Izmir, Turkey · 2013 – 2015
Started career in QA, building the instinct for quality that’s shaped everything since.

abstract.text: Senior iOS Developer with 12+ years of experience shipping apps that people actually use —
from real-time messaging platforms to fintech, transit, and enterprise tooling.
